decisions.reason: After another year on the market, this close-to-core delivery offer has accumulated operational commitment and can still be defended as a service refinement in a growing market rather than a failed concept.

The fire-resistant exterior door is highly visible, certification-intensive, and central to the firm's safety-oriented strategy, so prior investment and public commitment make withdrawal very unlikely.
A multi-model express line for doors and gates represents a substantial resource commitment and a clear market-facing promise, which under escalation logic strongly favors continuation.

Because this fire and smoke protection door extends the established compliance and protection portfolio, management is inclined to keep backing it unless there is unmistakable evidence of persistent failure.
